name: Adriel
description: A Serra Angel who awakens and chases Kyree after she takes the Ivory Cup.

timeline.summary: Kyree takes the Ivory Cup from Indorin's Tomb, awakening the Serra Angel Adriel, and escapes holding one of her feathers.
timeline.quote: she had lost the Ivory Cup but was instead clutching one of the angel's golden feathers

timeline.summary: Kyree takes the Ivory Cup from Indorin's sarcophagus, awakening Adriel, who chases her; Kyree escapes with an angel's feather and completes her rite.
timeline.quote: This feather is even more valued in the eyes of her tribe than the cup
